company.name: KARTY
company.shortDescription: KARTY develops a financial management platform that enables customers to spend, save, and manage finances in one application.
company.description: KARTY is a Fin-tech platform based in Msheireb, it allows customers to spend, save and manage all of their finances from one-app. It has raised $ 1.2 million in a pre-seed round from Visa, Qatar Development Bank (QDB), Qatar Foundation & Qatar based angel investors. KARTY aims to revolutionize the daily financial experiences for it’s customers by leveraging cutting-edge technology and transaction data. KARTY is working closely with strategic partner "Visa" to deliver full digital payment solutions for both consumer and business expenses.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,004,382, or 61.65% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,032,471 to $18,648,059, a 18.06x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 46 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 44 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
